input.summary: Cap renewal terms at 12 months and shorten the non-renewal notice window to 30 days.
input.comment: [Playbook] Renewals should be for 12 months with a short exit window; a 90-day window and renewals matching a multi-year prior term are too long. We can live with a 60-day window as a fallback.

ops.oldText: for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior
ops.newText: for an additional term of twelve (12) months (or the duration of the previous term, if shorter) unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least thirty (30) days prior

input.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' charges.
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not pay uncapped early-termination charges; as a fallback we accept a single liquidated amount capped at three months' charges for the terminated Services.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' recurring charges for the terminated Services and are the sole amounts payable by Customer in respect of such termination.
